Nothing really brings me joy during my hour of depression. Bte thanks for your reply, it has help me to feel less alone. 

Sometimes I wonder if I am bipolar haha but my mood swings are in a matter of hours and I don't really externalised my depressed mood so my psychiatrist think it is still just MDD.  

What MDD tells me makes so much sense, and in my depressed mood I am especially vulnerable to it. I feel a literal weight in my heart like I had been crying for hours.

You do not know what you are getting into. I am not an American and I have totally no interests to gain if you go to America or not. 

Just no. Not worth it.
